item.title: Pegfinity
item.description:
Title: Pegfinity
Genre: Casual , Indie
Developer: Fragment Ventures AS
Publisher: Fragment Ventures AS
Release Date: Aug 14, 2026




About This Game

What if one ball could break the entire board?

Pegfinity is a short colorful, pachinko-inspired physics-based incremental where a single shot can spiral into massive chain reactions, exploding scores, and absurd combos.

Launch balls, hit pegs, unlock chaotic upgrades, and turn a simple board into a ridiculous score-chasing machine.

You are always one lucky bounce away from your biggest run yet.

Between runs, unlock upgrades that push every shot further and make the board more chaotic.

  • Stack multipliers with the Hypemeter

  • Fill the board with explosive, electric, and gold pegs

  • Unlock gadgets that cheat physics: lasers, portals, a gumball machine, even a pinball bumper

  • Launch special balls that shatter, zap, spray watermelon juice, or disco the whole screen

  • Discover pegs that steal the run: chickens, UFOs, mirrors, clowns, and an atomic bomb that hits everything

  • Chase bigger combos, bigger payouts, and bigger score spikes

With over 150 upgrades to discover, every run gives you new ways to bend the board in your favor.
Every board is randomly generated. Every upgrade sticks. The game keeps handing you new ways to break it.

From simple bounces to ridiculous chaos

End with a board filled with effects, combos, and massive score spikes. Each run escalates:

  • More hits

  • Bigger numbers

  • More unpredictable outcomes

You’re always one lucky bounce away from your biggest run yet.

A Satisfying Progression Loop

Every hit is a small dopamine boost. Every run builds toward something bigger. Short sessions turn into long ones.

You launch one ball…

Then another…

Then one more to try something new…

And suddenly, everything clicks.

Permanent Power-Ups

Grow stronger over time with upgrades that carry across runs:

  • Multipliers

  • Stronger pegs

  • Bigger payouts

  • Game-changing boosts

Each run feeds into the next.

Inspired by a 150-year-old game

Pegfinity is inspired by a handcrafted pachinko-style board passed down through generations.

A simple idea, rebuilt into something faster, bigger, and far more chaotic.

  • Over 150 upgrades

  • Unlock unique pegs, balls, slots and cool gadgets

  • Random generated board - Each run is something new!

  • Permanent unlockable Power Ups!

  • And of course some biiiiiiiiiiig numbers!

See you in Pegfinity!

Descrierea conținutului pentru adulți indisponibilă.

System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10 64 Bit
    • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: DirectX 12 or Vulkan compatible, 1 GB VRAM
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 500 MB available space
    • Sound Card: Anything that can play sound
    Recommended:
    • OS: Windows 11 64 bit
    • Processor: Quad-core 3.0 GHz
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: DirectX 12 or Vulkan compatible, 2 GB VRAM
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 500 MB available space

item.title: TV Archive: Tidy Up Together
item.description:
Title: TV Archive: Tidy Up Together
Genre: Casual , Indie , Simulation
Developer: Games Together
Publisher: Games Together , Gamersky Games
Release Date: Aug 14, 2026




About This Game

This is a first-person organization simulation game where you shelve the videotapes, unlock new skills, and use your unique methods to tidy up the TV archive.

Game Modes

Solo, together, or competition...

Enjoy the different game modes: Single player, online co-op, and online PvP.

You can also try "Sandbox Mode", where all your skills are unlocked and always ready to use, or "No-Skill Mode" to challenge yourself.

Videotape Categories

Your task is to shelve 3,180 videotapes into the correct categories in the archive.

Action movies, drama movies, TV series, cartoons, horror movies, comedy movies, athletic games, football cups, romance movies, sci-fi movies, baseball, tennis, news, game shows, basketball, motorsport, cooking shows, documentaries, boxing, and talk shows.

Skills

  • Sorting Numerically: Sorts the videotapes in your hand in numerical order

  • Highlighting Shelf: Highlights the correct shelf for the topmost videotape in your hand

  • Highlighting Videotapes: Highlights the same videotapes as the topmost videotape in your hand

  • Auto-Placement: Automatically places your videotapes on the shelf in the correct order

  • Auto-Collect: Automatically collects the same videotapes as the topmost videotape in your hand

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

AI was used only as a supporting tool for the design of fictional images on the videotapes.



System Requirements

Windows

* Starting January 1st, 2024, the Steam Client will only support Windows 10 and later versions.
    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS *: Windows 7 64-bit | Windows 8 64-bit | Windows 10 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400F | AMD Ryzen 5 5600x
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 | AMD Radeon R9-290X
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 2800 MB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS *: Windows 7 64-bit | Windows 8 64-bit | Windows 10 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-13400F | AMD Ryzen 5 7600x
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 | AMD Radeon RX-6600
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 2800 MB available space

item.title: Lootbound
item.description:
Title: Lootbound
Genre: Adventure , Casual , Indie , RPG , Strategy
Developer: ArtDock
Publisher: Dreland Enterprises
Release Date: Aug 14, 2026




About This Game

Lootbound: take risks, build your squad and create your build

Every run starts with you alone.

As you move across the map, choose a route that leads to valuable loot. Along the way, you will meet companions who will help you fight this difficult battle!

Team and equipment

You need to collect a separate set of equipment for the hero and each companion.

Items do not have fixed slots. You can rotate them and place them in the inventory as long as there is free space.

Item auras

Items become truly powerful when they start affecting one another. Some items have auras that strengthen weapons or armor in adjacent cells.

Sometimes moving an item by a single cell is enough to change the entire build.

Companions and abilities

In combat, you control only the main hero.

Companions act on their own. They already know what to do...

Create the final GUARDIAN

At the end of each biome, you choose one of two boss parts.

Each part changes the Guardian's appearance and power. After completing all biomes, you will have to face the final boss.

Risk and reward

Some rewards in Lootbound cannot be obtained just like that.

In special rooms, you are offered several options with different difficulty levels. The more valuable the reward, the harder it is to obtain with a dice roll.

This is Lootbound...

item.title: Tidy Up Together
item.description:
Title: Tidy Up Together
Genre: Casual , Indie , Simulation
Developer: Malum Games
Publisher: Malum Games
Release Date: Aug 14, 2026




About This Game

NO AI WAS USED IN THE MAKING OF THIS GAME

Tidy Up Together is a cozy organizing simulator about restoring your fantasy Adventurer's shop. An evil wizard has blasted thousands of your products all over the floor - and it's your job to put them back!

Shop Restoration

Item by item you'll build the shop back to its former tidiness. There's an incredible range of products ranging from potions to sushi. Those Greatswords really shouldn't be mixing with the pineapples...

Multiplayer

It's a mighty big puzzle to solve. Maybe some friends could help you out?

Don't worry if you'd prefer to tidy at your own pace; the game is also perfect in single player!

Abilities

That wizard isn't the only one who knows some magic. As you tidy you'll be inspired to learn new abilities to help maximise your efficiency.

Key Features

  • Multiplayer - Invite as many friends as you like to help you out.

  • Character Customization with multiple outfits.

  • 3 Levels of varying sizes.

  • Full Controller support.

  • 650, 2500 and almost 10,000 items across 14 categories and three shops.

  • Ability upgrades.

  • No time limits (but you can see completion time at the end) and no game over. Tidy Up at your own pace!

item.title: EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 27
item.description:
Title: EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 27
Genre: Simulation , Sports , Strategy
Developer: Tiburon
Publisher: Electronic Arts
Franchise: EA Sports
Release Date: Aug 13, 2026




About This Game



Run the league one decision at a time. EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 27, powered by the all-new Persona Engine, transforms Franchise into a reactive, always-evolving league where every NFL athlete has a distinct, realistic personality that informs their motivations, demands and reactions. Gameplay gets physical with more precise control from authentic WR/DB battles, new short-yardage mechanics, defensive coverage improvements and new strategic pre-play settings and controls. Build your NFL legacy on a deeper progression path in the new Superstar G.O.A.T. Career Journey and control your roster with more customization with Ultimate Team Captains.

FRANCHISE

The all-new Persona Engine gives every NFL athlete a distinct personality that informs their motivations, how they think and how they respond, transforming your Franchise into a reactive ever-evolving league shaped by every move you make.

GAMEPLAY

Authentic NFL Physicality

Every snap is a battle for control. All-new WR/DB interactions bring true NFL physicality to every route, with realistic hand-fighting, jostling, and leverage that define separation and coverage. Win tight 50-50 moments with timing-based catching and refined contested interactions, or take command in critical situations with improved short-yardage mechanics and plays like the “Tush Push” that decide games when inches matter most.

Gameplanning & Customization

Own every decision before and after the snap. New gameplan adjustments let you preconfigure how your team aligns and reacts, while streamlined pre-play controls put every adjustment at your fingertips. Smarter receiver logic keeps plays alive, while advanced coverage systems and plaster logic help defenses adapt in real time giving you total control to execute your strategy on every snap.

SUPERSTAR

Become the greatest NFL Superstar of all time through an expanded G.O.A.T. Career Journey. Progress from high school to the Hall of Fame with deeper skill trees, new playable positions and unlock meaningful career choices as your legacy grows.

ULTIMATE TEAM


PRESENTATION

The sights and sounds of NFL Sundays bring expanded stadium traditions and broadcast moments to frame the storylines of every game day. From Denver’s pregame skydivers to Jaxson de Ville’s zip line in Jacksonville, new intros, drone shows, and holiday broadcast packages elevate every matchup to big-game energy.

DYNAMIC WEATHER

Dynamic Weather can disrupt your strategy as you face evolving conditions throughout a game. A sunny kickoff in Tampa Bay might turn into a third‑quarter downpour before clearing again. Field degradation makes turf progressively tougher to play on, impacting player movement, stamina, ball security and strategy.

System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 11
    • Processor: Intel Core i3-10300 (4 cores, 8 threads) / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
    • Memory: 12 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT / Intel Arc A580
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 50 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: SSD recommended; 8 logical CPU cores minimum; Intel Arc GPUs require Resizable BAR (ReBAR) enabled to meet expected performance Estimated performance when set to ""Low"" preset: 1920x1080 @ 60 FPS
    Recommended:
    • OS: Windows 11
    • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700 / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3060 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT / Intel Arc B580
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 50 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: SSD recommended; 8 logical CPU cores minimum; Intel Arc GPUs require Resizable BAR (ReBAR) enabled to meet expected performance Estimated performance when set to ""High"" preset: 2560x1440 @ 60 FPS
